prompt:
Create one combination logo for Folio. Exact text (copy verbatim, no other words): 'Folio'. Exact slogan: ''.
Render only the supplied exact text and nonempty slogan; the brand context is not additional lettering. Empty strings request no corresponding text.
Industry: Independent stationery and notebook products. Audience: Adult professionals and creators who enjoy organizing thoughts on paper.
Styles: compact paper-layer symbol, calm humanist lettering, contemporary, considered, flat. Original brief palette context: #A76148, #333B39, #FFFFFF.
Avoid: stock notebook or pen clip art, basic glyph icon, extra lettering, excessively vintage or luxury-hotel styling. Use cases: 180px-wide online-shop header lockup, notebook packaging label.
Background: opaque. Produce a real PNG raster image. Use clean, readable shapes at small sizes; leave safe margins. Do not draw a transparency checkerboard, mockup, watermarks, or a concept grid.
Concept direction: For an independent notebook and stationery brand for adult professionals and creators, place a compact original paper-layer gesture to the left of the exact word "Folio" in one horizontal lockup. Build the small symbol from two broad, offset paper-like planes with a restrained stepped outer contour and one short open fold interval; use an oblique corner to suggest a fold without a page outline, ruled lines, notebook binding or pen glyph. Fill the planes with muted clay #A76148 and let the single interior interval remain white. Keep the symbol visually around the height of the capital F, with enough open space before the name that it does not become another letter. Letter Folio in graphite #333B39 with a medium-weight low-contrast humanist sans appearance, softly resolved terminals, generous o counters and a clear l stem; preserve capital F and lowercase olio on one steady baseline. Let the word carry most of the lockup width, with balanced Fo, ol, li and io spacing. At the total 180px header width the fold interval, both o counters and the exact name must remain clear. Use opaque pure #FFFFFF over the whole exterior canvas including all four corners, without paper texture, mockups, shadows, hotel-style hairline serifs or vintage decoration.. Assumptions: A left-hand symbol with a larger text block is the proposed horizontal arrangement for the 180px shop header., A plain white master is selected within the delegated background choice; paper texture belongs to no requested deliverable..
Brand rendering: flat, front-facing product artwork by default; one clear idea, deliberate negative space and balanced optical weight. No paper texture, beige tint, presentation lighting, shadows or cinematic effects unless explicitly requested. Requested styles/concept override these surface defaults; depth and extra tones must obey the palette and gradient policy. Use the explicitly requested solid canvas or declared background role first; otherwise plain white #FFFFFF. User canvas and color/count requirements take precedence over this white fallback.
Logo construction: Make a combination mark with a distinct symbol and the supplied exact text. Use the concept for the symbol subject and the effective lockup, when supplied, for arrangement and typeface appearance. Balance the symbol's visual weight with the lettering, keep a clear symbol-to-text gap and open letter counters, and include a slogan only when supplied. An icon alone is not this lockup. Use style references for broad construction traits, not their brand words or traced signature shapes. The identity should remain recognizable in a one-color silhouette at the intended use size. This construction check does not replace the requested palette or request an extra monochrome image.
